set.body:
Scope: modules/image world types, ../image4s optional neuroimaging module (or U0-selected home), ../reframe4s.

Deliverable: Move anatomical/template/subject frame declarations to their agreed common home; put generic directional WorldLink/map capabilities in reframe4s. Keep dataset/BIDS assembly and surface loading policy downstream.

Acceptance:
- Volume and surface clients consume one frame catalog/declaration contract with no dependency back to ScalaFIM or neurosurf4s.
- Unavailable inverse directions are rejected explicitly; exact/sampled route meaning survives.
- Scanner/tkRAS/template placement and transforms-applied-once fixtures pass on JVM/JS.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U2: Externalize shared neuroimaging declarations and directional links
